# Brief

Hand-written, no brief: the v0.5 portal-scope fixture, `vet-portal`'s
owners' portal loaded and derived beside `vet-core`'s record (and
`vet-lab`'s laboratory, which the derivation reads) through `gmctl
load-data`, and its API, for the short test of
`security-policy-ownership-end-dropped` (s5, chunk 25),
`run-short-test.sh`. Not a game.
